title: Unit Event — The Vivid Old Tale — Episode2 The One Called Nagi Kotaki

meta.Episode: Episode2 — The One Called Nagi Kotaki
meta.Event Outline: After successfully hosting their own event for the first time, Vivid BAD SQUAD is determined to ride that wave closer to the heights of RAD WEEKEND. As they're discussing that legendary event, the members start to want to know more about Nagi, the woman who played a central role.

rows.Line: A few years ago
Saturday morning

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna give it everything I've got again today!

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Hm?
Whoa, who's that...?! She's so little, but such an amazing singer...!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Oh, boss, I was just cleaning up and noticed that little girl singing over there...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Ah, you're still new here, so I guess no one's told you yet...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: You know KEN from RADder? That's his daughter, An.

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Wait, KEN's...?!

rows.Speaker: Local Residents
rows.Line: Hey, it looks like An's singing already!

rows.Speaker: Local Residents
rows.Line:
Yeah.
The way she's always practicing is so admirable too!

rows.Speaker: Local Residents
rows.Line: We're rooting for you, An!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice songs! Next, I should...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Hi, An!
Getting another early start this morning?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Oh, good morning!
Did you just get off work?

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm exhausted...
But I feel much better after hearing you sing, An♪ So, thank you♪

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome!
Stop by to listen anytime!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh, you're from the record store! Good morning! Lots of cool piercings like always!

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...
You seem as energetic as ever too, An...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Yup!
Oh, I was just practicing that song you taught me the other day!

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line:
R-Really?
That's nice to hear...

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Wow, she seems like a really energetic kid...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Yeah, not only is she a great singer, she's got the charisma to match. Genetics are probably playing a big role, but... Hey, An!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, good morning!
How are you? Good?

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
Yeah, never better!
Are you at it again today? The thing Ken and the others were...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Because “this street's the best place to practice singing”!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Daddy was supposed to watch me practice, but he's busy and still hasn't come yet...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: I see. To be fair, he's a very popular figure...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yup! It's like everyone's a fan of Daddy and his team!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Did you hire someone new?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
O-Oh, um...
I started working here last week. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: This one's a huge fan of your father, An.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh, really?!

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: W-Wait, that's...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally get why too. I mean, Daddy's just so cool! You've got a good eye! Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: But I'm gonna become an even more amazing musician than him, so make sure to come see my events when I do!

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Oh, of course!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Now, I should get back to practicing!
See you guys later!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
That's pretty much what she's like.
Pretty good kid, right...?

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
Yes, she is.
She really takes after KEN...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Whew. I got in a lot of singing...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I figured out how to sing that new song and got that rap down too. Things are going really well!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(But it's almost noon...
Where are you, Daddy?)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Even after saying that he'd come watch me practice today...)
An, over here!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi! Uncle Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hi there!
Having another morning practice, An?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been practicing for like three hours now! Are you two here to talk to Daddy?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yes, since we need to get ready for today's event. I hope you're looking forward to seeing us sing our hearts out!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah, I am! Hehe... I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. An just can't get enough of you, Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, is Ken still at home?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: No, he got a call from someone and has been gone since! He was supposed to watch me practice...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... He mentioned something about wanting to talk to some kids before they make their big debut. It could have to do with that.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Unlike me, a lot of them see him as their role model since he always keeps an eye out for them.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You say that, but I've seen you lend a helping hand on more than one occasion, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember how you helped cheer that one kid up after they dropped their ice cream!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I couldn't just leave them, could I?
I mean, if that were me, dropping my ice cream would've felt like the end of the world.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: True. I probably would've felt awful the rest of the day too...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Haha. Oh, quit exaggerating, you two.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, I just got a message from Ken...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, he says he still can't come...
Which means we have some time to kill.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Grr! Daddy!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Can you listen to me sing, Aunt Nagi, Uncle Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I practiced lots and lots, so I bet I'll sound really good!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Sure, I'd love to hear you sing!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But I'll probably fall asleep if you don't deliver, okay?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
No problem!
Daddy even said that I sounded great yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, he did?
Then, I'm looking forward to hearing what you have in store for us♪

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Alright, here I go!!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Not bad!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oh, stop there!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That last part. I think you'll sound a lot better and more powerful if you don't use your falsetto. Here, like this.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Wow...!
How did you do that just now?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Start by using your diaphragm to project your voice and send it up towards your head. It's okay if you're not in pitch on your first try.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Um...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Yeah, there you go!
Next, relax a bit more and try to keep your throat open... Go!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yay! I did it!
Thank you so much, Aunt Nagi!!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Haha. It's always a pleasure to teach you since you're such a quick learner, An. Now, fist bump!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Fist bump!
se_event_tale_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Heh.
You two are more like sisters at this point... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper A
rows.Line: What?! Don't give me that!

rows.Speaker: Boy Rapper B
rows.Line: You wanna go?! Meet me out front!

rows.Speaker: Onlookers
rows.Line: Hey, guys, cut it out!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hm? Uh oh. Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: A fight...?!
